summary: External storage transfer statistics incorrectly sum individual driver invocation durations instead of measuring actual wall-clock time. When multiple drivers run concurrently, the reported duration is multiplied by the number of drivers rather than reflecting actual elapsed time.
userImpact: Users receive inaccurate transfer statistics that overestimate actual external storage operation duration, hindering performance monitoring and observability.
rootCause: The statistics tracking code sums individual driver invocation durations instead of measuring the actual wall-clock time spanning all concurrent operations.
proposedFix: Use edge detection to track and record durations.
keyQuote: External storage transfer stats are summing the durations of each driver invocation instead of tracking overlapping intervals.
